content: BullMQ source (master, src/interfaces/base-job-options.ts + worker-options.ts): priority ranges 0-2097151; 0 = no explicit priority and non-prioritized jobs are processed BEFORE prioritized jobs; for prioritized jobs lower numbers processed before higher; slight performance cost. CRITICAL for D-12: if routine checks carry no priority they outrank prioritized manual checks - every lane needs an explicit priority. attempts default 1. removeOnComplete/removeOnFail accept {age,count} KeepJobs; eviction best-effort - BullMQ does not run a background timer, aged jobs only removed once another job completes/fails after expiration (D-14 DLQ 7-day retention is approximate). Worker defaults: concurrency 1, stalledInterval 30000ms, maxStalledCount 1, lockDuration 30000ms, lockRenewTime lockDuration/2.
